# miniz

Vendored from https://github.com/richgel999/miniz at tag `3.1.2`, commit
`77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d`. The upstream source files are
unmodified. `miniz_export.h` supplies the static-library export definition
normally generated by upstream CMake. Only ZIP reading and decompression are
enabled. See LICENSE for the MIT license and copyright notices.
